info.title: RC filter Bode plot
info.question: Where does a low-pass filter begin to attenuate?
info.expected: A 1 kΩ /1 µF low-pass crosses about 159 Hz at −3 dB and −45°. Gain rolls off above it.
info.try: Open Sweeps and run the prepared AC range. Select gain or phase, click a point and compare half-power estimates.
info.limitation: Normalized small-signal response around DC bias; captured sweep leaves the live circuit unchanged.

matching_parts.limitations: Linear charge reservoir: OCV=Vfull*q/Q; Q=3600*capacity_Ah; ESR voltage sag. Equivalent stored energy=Q*Vfull*SOC^2/2. Positive delivered current discharges; externally forced charging is an ideal reversible reservoir, not a charger model. Startup SOC is 0..1; live SOC outside that range is reported, not hidden.
